history.rationale: Initial seed policy baseline on stratified val (12 tasks).

WarehouseLinker failed to (1) proactively probe partition metadata and opaque code columns for HIVE latest-partition questions, so generators emitted dynamic MAX(ds)/MAX_PT/subquery partition filters that Hive rejects or that trigger full-scan violations; (2) record exact probed max_partition literals and actual code mappings unambiguously in schema_notes; (3) synthesize non-requested lifecycle/status predicates such as settled-status filters, causing silent undercounting; and (4) guess code values without probing, producing wrong status filters.

The generator repeatedly produced empty or undercounted results because it compared SCD2 date columns with inconsistent formats directly (e.g. raw YYYYMMDD event date against raw YYYY-MM-DD effective bounds and NULL/empty open-ended eff_end_dt), and because it invented hardcoded positive enum inclusion lists for business qualifiers like 'external/commercial' instead of using schema_notes/probed code mappings, silently dropping all rows or undercounting point-in-time joins.

Initial SQL returned empty primarily due to date/partition format mismatch, but the refiner misattributed the empty result to the business status/risk code whitelists and replaced strict equality predicates with loose negative-list filters, silently including non-normal/risk rows and producing incorrect aggregates. Linker also failed to probe opaque status/risk code columns, so code mappings were guessed rather than verified.

Merged by retaining Candidate A's evolved HIVE-compliant generator rules (authoritative schema_notes/probe usage, partition pruning, SCD2 date normalization, fanout protection, unit conversion, and CTE patterns) since Candidate B left the generator at the minimal ancestor. Retained Candidate B's evolved refiner diagnosis/caliber-audit guardrails since Candidate A left the refiner at the minimal ancestor, with its MAX_PT phrasing corrected to state MAX_PT does not exist and explicit schema_notes literals are authoritative. The linker was kept minimal but enriched with HIVE partition-probing guidance so max_partition literals reach schema_notes. All overlapping rules were deduplicated while preserving distinct non-conflicting checks from both parents.

The linker inferred an unrequested lifecycle/status predicate from vague business wording ('formal external commercial orders') and recorded it as authoritative schema_notes. The generator applied that predicate verbatim, silently excluding valid non-settled rows and producing lower counts and amounts. The linker also asserted a count-grain equivalence without probing row/grain semantics, leaving COUNT DISTINCT vs COUNT(1) ambiguous.
